_comment: Pins capitalAvoided() and stack() across every candidate. Re-cut for the shutdown-model unification: site-infrastructure.js's flat 0.35 shutdown discount was site-capex.js's bopRetained floor with the age curve above it dropped, and the curve is now asked for on generation and gasTreatment only. avoidedDigest therefore MOVED, deliberately — 462 sites of 11,829, 184 up and 278 down, +$118,368,647 avoided across the catalogue, and totalBuildUsd identical on every one because a discount only divides avoided from required. Electrical, civil and collection keep their flat discounts; site-capex.js has no refurb model for them and inventing one would be a category error.
_stack_digest_was_vacuous: stackDigest ALSO moved, and for a different reason: the old serialisation passed usable_kw to stack(), which reads powerPotentialKw. Every one of the 11,829 stacks bailed at the capacity check and returned zero components, so the digest pinned 'stack() returns nothing' — which is why adding a whole collection component to the stack did not disturb it. The serialisation now passes powerPotentialKw and sourceDetail, the test asserts both serialisations actually priced something before trusting either digest, and it asserts the stack digest can see a collection component at all.
